items.title: 9.4 Developing Effective Marketing and Sales Strategies (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of marketing and sales strategies (PDF 216).

blocks.text: Marketing aur sales karobaron ko gahak lane, sales barhane aur brand barhane mein madad dete hain. Yeh hissa Pakistan ki misalon se marketing aur sales ki hikmat-e-amli banata hai.

blocks.prompt: Mo-assar marketing ka aham juz kya hai (MCQ 7)?

items: Marketing aur sales gahak late, sales barhate aur brand banate hain.
